articles.title: U.S. strikes on Iran fail to stir bitcoin, on track for best month since November 2024
articles.snippet: Bitcoin held steady despite a broader risk-off move after the first U.S. strikes against Iran for weeks sent oil higher and stocks lower. The cryptocurrency has gained 24% this month.

articles.title: September Fed rate hike fears look overblown as the probability stands at just 58%, not 90%
articles.snippet: Odds of a rate hike in September remain below 60% despite Warsh's hawkish speech on Friday. Observers downplay fears of tightening.

articles.title: Ditching 'digital gold': BPI study suggests everyday Americans prefer control and micro-investing
articles.snippet: A new survey suggests some of bitcoin's most familiar sales pitches of changing the world may be poorly suited to a majority of prospective buyers.

articles.title: Markets pivot to September Fed rate hike: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.snippet: Bitcoin approached the August monthly close below key resistance with markets once again pricing in a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in September.

articles.title: Stellar tokenized RWA market more than quadruples to nearly $4B
articles.snippet: Stellar’s real-world asset market has expanded rapidly this year as institutional adoption and tokenization activity grow across the network.
